scope: chun temporal arm only; FCP remains independent
question: What is repeated, retained and lost across visible phenotypes, biochemical identity, molecular modules and evolutionary time?

temporal.interpretation: Relative-divergence description of fine visible-colour pair similarity; not an independent replication of resolution-profile AUC and not calibrated absolute time

resolutions.caveat: 28 clades share one source and ontology; 16 no-signal results are not evidence of no nested structure

case_camellia.caveat: Same-system contrasts include within-cultivar/developmental series, not independently reconstructed macroevolutionary events; score 1/3 and 1/2 are n-dependent Simpson floors

cross_tier_linkage.valid_claim: Parallel evidence for heterogeneity and nested evolutionary structure; no demonstrated causal relationship between mechanism reuse and temporal memory strength

new_single_radiation_matched_petunieae_b.interpretation: Nested fine-pigment conditional expression phylogenetic organization on one shared tree; not a genetic causality test and not linked to the 32-radiation temporal decay coefficients

prospectively_testable_bridge.biological_target: Within the same phylogeny, compare depth-dependent retention of visible color, biochemical pigment identity, and gene/pathway modules among appropriately matched taxa
prospectively_testable_bridge.primary_test: After the tree/tip join and trait ontologies are frozen, test whether within-coarse fine-state retention and molecular implementation concordance show a reproducible distance-dependent relationship

admissibility.independently_admitted_radiations: at least two is a proposed validation target, not a result
admissibility.no_expected_sign_from_prior_outcomes: freeze an explicit prediction or competing sign hypotheses before new decisive outcomes

public_first_candidates.status: Same-source 47-tip biochemistry and gene-expression conditional phylogenetic association completed retrospectively; generalization still requires independent same-tip radiations
published same-system pigment/expression phylogeny; repository exact-source recovery is HOLD; do not substitute data without new frozen provenance gate
illustrative standardized transcript-contrast case; cannot map its five comparisons directly to accepted-species transition branches

governance.freeze: Paper 1 science v0.2.2, framing v0.3.4, AJB v1.0 and Evolution Letters v0.3 are unchanged

prior_art.lesson: Ng & Smith 2016 already found phylogenetic signal in pigment mechanisms within convergent red flowers
Larter et al. 2018 already found pathway-level regulatory convergence by transition type
Multilevel convergence is established conceptual prior art
